# The Dispatch worker runs on the Windows operator desktop and laptop.
scripts/dispatch-worker/**

# PowerShell files run only on Windows hosts (install, staging, auth sync, taskmaster).
**/*.ps1

# The CLI is installed on Windows and setup.ts branches on win32.
packages/cli/**

# archon-paths.ts creates a junction on win32 and is imported by the CLI and dispatch.
packages/paths/**

# session-launcher.ts branches on win32.
packages/core/src/orchestrator/session-launcher.ts

# recovery.ts branches on win32.
packages/core/src/workflows/recovery.ts

# worktree.ts branches on win32.
packages/git/src/worktree.ts

# exec.ts leaves Windows teardown unverifiable and must not signal a tree.
packages/git/src/exec.ts

# Claude binary resolution branches on win32.
packages/providers/src/claude/binary-resolver.ts

# Codex binary resolution branches on win32.
packages/providers/src/codex/binary-resolver.ts

# Grok provider tools branch on win32.
packages/providers/src/community/grok/tools.ts

# dag-executor.ts resolves bun.cmd on win32.
packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts

# Workflow edits decide when Windows CI runs, so they must run Windows CI.
.github/workflows/test.yml

# Path-list edits must run Windows CI so a bad glob cannot skip itself.
.github/windows-paths.txt

# The classifier and skip helper are the Windows CI gate.
scripts/windows-ci/**

# The root package manifest changes what the Windows job installs and runs.
package.json

# The lockfile changes the dependency set the Windows job installs.
bun.lock

# Root bunfig changes test discovery and preloads for the Windows job.
bunfig.toml

# A package manifest changes that package's Windows test script.
packages/*/package.json

# A package bunfig changes that package's Windows test preload and timeout.
packages/*/bunfig.toml

# The shared test preload sets the timeout used by Windows package-serial runs.
packages/core/src/test/setup.ts
